description: Closes a local session; it NEVER checks in to the Project Server. Closing discards every pending change of the session, so a session with unsaved changes (or whose modified state cannot be read) is refused with 409 unsaved_changes (details.session, details.path) until the call chooses: save:true saves it first (multiuser or exclusive sessions only; otherwise 409 save_not_supported and nothing is closed) or discard:true drops the changes; both together are 400 bad_request. Every object handle of the session dies with it. Returns {closed:true, action, session} with action close, save_then_close or discard_then_close. `session` is the name or the full path of an open local session (as listed by tia_local_sessions; the project path first, then the project name ignoring case) and may be left out when exactly one session is open: none open is 409 no_local_session, several open without `session` (or a selector that matches several) is 409 ambiguous_session (details.sessions lists index, name and path), an unknown one is 404 not_found. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve and reports the action or the same refusal WITHOUT closing. Nothing is ever checked in to the Project Server: check-in (CloseAndCommit) is not offered by any tool. Maps to POST /multiuser/localsessions/close {session?, save?, discard?}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

discard.description: close it and drop its pending changes; never together with save

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

save.description: save the session before closing it (multiuser or exclusive sessions only)

session.description: name or full path of the open local session (from tia_local_sessions); optional when exactly one session is open

name: tia_local_session_close
title: TIA — close a local session
